name: Lux
text: When you hear me, we're on the clock. Your next work update, without another tab.

name: Rex
text: That's my voice. Time for the project you can't stop thinking about after work.

name: Luna
text: Hear me? This one's for you. Your plans, your reminders, your life outside work.

name: Atlas
text: My voice means there's something worth knowing. I'll bring you the findings, not the noise.

name: Cosmo
text: When you hear me, curiosity is calling. Let's figure out something new.

name: Celeste
text: That's me keeping things moving. The next step, the right moment, nothing forgotten.
